records.speaker: Candace Owens

verification.notes: The hearing record directly contradicts the statement's characterization. The cited ATF testimony concerned DNA mixtures, not six sets of fingerprints. The expert said the trigger/trigger-guard sample contained at least four contributors, that the major DNA profile showed the greatest degradation in that sample, and that the DNA profiles were at least one trillion times more likely if Tyler Robinson was the major contributor. Separate latent-print testimony described three comparable or poorly comparable prints and excluded Robinson from those three. The statement conflates DNA and fingerprints and misstates the contributor count.
